svg.title: Element-wise subslot sampling and pilot/data frame structure
svg.desc: A chosen element of the holographic surface yields one intensity sample per temporal subslot. Five representative subslots of a symbol with M subslots are displayed. Aligned ellipses indicate omitted intervals. The highlighted sample at index m belongs to the selected data symbol in the frame intensity matrix.
